Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. You can't delete an opponent's Digimon, but you can trash a card in your hand.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Deletion] inherited effect to trash 1 card in my hand even if my opponent has no level 3 Digimon when the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards is deleted?

Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] By trashing 1 card in your hand, delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon.
